---
title: "Banana Bread"
description: The blacker the bananas, the better this is.
categories: [baking, snack, vegetarian, make-ahead]
time: 1 h 15 min
servings: 10 slices
---

## Ingredients

- 3 very ripe bananas
- 115 g butter, melted
- 150 g brown sugar
- 2 eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 200 g plain flour
- 1 tsp baking soda
- ½ tsp salt
- 1 tsp cinnamon
- 75 g walnuts, roughly chopped

## Method

1. Heat the oven to 175 °C and line a 900 g loaf tin.
2. Mash the bananas in a large bowl until almost smooth. Stir in the melted butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla.
3. Add the flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon on top and fold until *just* combined — a few dry streaks are better than overmixing.
4. Fold through the walnuts.
5. Pour into the tin and bake for 55–65 minutes, until a skewer in the middle comes out with damp crumbs but no batter.
6. Cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack. Cutting it hot makes it gummy.
